scope: Source-scope review only; full-model execution and publication remain separate requirements.

source_stage_review.realization: Accept four selected ordered time frames per example; the single branch uses frame3 and the temporal branch uses all four.
source_stage_review.correction: Replace the inaccurate five-frame window claim. Upstream selection, time spacing, input decoding and alignment are caller responsibilities.

source_stage_review.realization: Apply the exact source inverted three-channel thermal-difference transform with fixed offsets/scales and no clipping, then source branch-specific resizing.
source_stage_review.correction: This is a physical encoding assumption, not generic RGB normalization. Callers must preserve the channel scale and order; shape validation alone does not establish them.

source_stage_review.realization: Arrange four three-channel frames into a spatial panel with frame order3,0 / 1,2. Keep temporal quadrants fixed under spatial augmentation.
source_stage_review.correction: Replace the inaccurate fifteen-channel temporal stacking claim. The temporal network receives a three-channel spatial panel; the other branch receives a single three-channel frame.

source_stage_review.realization: Train both full MaxViT/U-Net branches across every selected fold, preserving source decoder/head differences, shifted-label geometry, augmented-loss masking, AdamW, scheduling, validation-break timing and terminal checkpoint reload.
source_stage_review.correction: The source realization selects MaxViT rather than an interchangeable ConvNeXt alternative. It does not operate on a fifteen-channel input. Explicit shortened epochs and random initialization qualify execution only, not historical accuracy.

source_stage_review.realization: Run eight-way spatial D4 probability averaging for each selected checkpoint; combine folds and branches using the exact unnormalized source weights and encode the strict0.5 decision as column-major run lengths.
source_stage_review.correction: Replace temporal-window shifting with spatial rotations/flips. Threshold diagnostics do not replace the fixed final threshold, and weighted outputs are not calibrated probabilities.

reuse_decision: Other aligned thermal-image segmentation tasks may reuse the recipe only when the source physical encoding, temporal order, target meaning, transformation invariances and fold assumptions are justified. Domain-neutral keys and arrays do not remove those assumptions. Preparation and execution remain recipe adapters; generic spatial augmentation or mask encoding would need independent provider contracts and qualification before separate selection.
limitations: Shape and finiteness checks do not establish physical units, channel identity or temporal spacing. Arbitrary RGB or unrelated numeric channels do not satisfy the semantic contract merely by matching shape.
Caller must justify spatial transformation invariance and target alignment in any new application. This is a fixed two-branch recipe; generic temporal averaging is not implemented.

Distinct keys do not prove independent subjects, locations, times or arrays. Scoring participates in diagnostics and is not an independent final evaluation. Annotation means must retain their intended meaning.
Prepared state is neither deeply immutable nor a safe untrusted deserialization boundary. Callers must avoid mutation between preparation and execution; detached copying is not promised.

Weight shape checks do not certify provenance. No pretrained downloads or historical predictive parity. Callers must set num_workers=0 and bound Torch, native pools and OpenCV for the shared resource budget; source defaults do not enforce that budget.

The field named probabilities is a source-weighted sum that can exceed one; it is not a calibrated posterior. Diagnostic threshold sweeps do not replace the fixed final threshold. No trained model is returned for later reuse.
remaining: Complete both full-model variants with explicit bounded resources and dependency integrity.
Review provider contracts and reconcile metadata with rollback gates.
Stage and execute the corrected stored original; qualify publication and served selection.
